veranderings.voor: glo MIV gaan oor deur 'n drukkie, 'n beker of 'n muskietbyt
veranderings.na: glo MIV gaan deur 'n drukkie, 'n beker of 'n muskietbyt oor
veranderings.rede: The separable verb 'oorgaan' puts 'oor' at the end of the clause, as the lesson itself does in 'MIV gaan nie deur 'n drukkie of 'n beker oor nie'.
Fronting 'Ook' is stiff; 'Dit is ook vals' is the natural order at this grade.

veranderings.voor: help wel mense om gesond te bly
veranderings.na: help mense wel om gesond te bly
veranderings.rede: The modal particle 'wel' sits more naturally after the object 'mense'.
'Uitsorteer' calques English 'sort out'; the meaning here is to recognise the myths, which is 'uitken'.

veranderings.voor: van 'n ma na haar baba, en deur seks
veranderings.na: van 'n ma na haar baba en deur seks
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: no comma before 'en' in a list.

veranderings.voor: as hulle beddegoed of klere vat
veranderings.na: as hulle beddegoed of klere hanteer
veranderings.rede: 'Vat' is colloquial for handling soiled items; 'hanteer' is clearer and still grade-appropriate.

veranderings.voor: 'n Kind help op gewone maniere by die huis
veranderings.na: 'n Kind kan op gewone maniere by die huis help
veranderings.rede: The bare present reads as a statement of fact about every child; 'kan ... help' matches the following 'Jy kan' sentences and reads naturally.

veranderings.blok: Wie sorg, het ook hulp nodig
veranderings.voor: Dalk moet jy self te veel van die sorg dra
veranderings.na: Dalk dra jy self te veel van die sorg
veranderings.rede: 'Dalk moet jy ... dra' can be misread as advice that the child should carry too much; 'Dalk dra jy' states the situation without that ambiguity.

vlae.blok: MIV en VIGS is nie dieselfde nie
vlae.teks: Die medisyne keer dit by die meeste mense wat dit elke dag drink.
vlae.rede: 'Die medisyne' has no earlier antecedent in the lesson, and the two 'dit's refer to different things (VIGS, then the medicine); the protected phrase blocks a rewrite of the second half, so a writer should decide whether the opening needs a clearer reference.
